subject: [PATCH 6.18.y] mm/hugetlb: fix swap entry corruption when clearing uffd-wp at fork()

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: Queued the patch for 6.18 without raising any technical concerns or objections.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Aug 05, 2026 at 02:43:46PM +0100, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> Migration entries legitimately carry uffd-wp, so clear it with
> pte_swp_clear_uffd_wp(), matching copy_nonpresent_pte() and
> move_huge_pte().

Queued for 6.18, thanks.

-- 
Thanks,
Sasha

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch fixes a swap entry corruption issue when clearing the uffd-wp bit at fork() in hugetlb code. The problem occurs because the present-PTE bit position is different from where the uffd-wp state is stored, leading to incorrect updates. The fix involves using pte_swp_clear_uffd_wp() instead of huge_pte_clear_uffd_wp() for migration entries and removing the clear operation for hwpoison entries.
